name: Negative — User Asks Policy Details
goal: User asks a policy or coverage question; bot must redirect to Knowledge Base.
constraints: User attempts to get policy details instead of booking.

testdata.user_policy_question: What is covered in the annual health checkup?

phases.completionCriteria: Bot does not answer, redirects to Knowledge Base.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
